page: Microsoft Azure E16ds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz. It provides 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 48 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Memory capacity is 128.0 GB, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per virtual core. Storage is provisioned via an integrated 644 GB local SSD, and the instance supports Azure Premium Storage. The system includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not contain dedicated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark measurements position the E16ds_v5 in the middle 50 percent for multi-core and single-core general compute workloads, returning a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,078.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 21,234.25. Memory subsystem throughput reaches 52.98 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 38.57 GB/sec for uncached writes, complementing a PassMark memory score of 2,737.87. In-memory data workloads yield 15.92 million Redis SET operations per second and 22.0 GB/sec static web throughput. Small-model LLM generation exhibits strong performance at 289.27 tokens per second for a 135M model.

With its 8 GB per vCPU allocation and included NVMe-backed local SSD scratch space, the E16ds_v5 offers balanced resource efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Workloads that match this profile include enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caching systems, transactional data processing, and analytics pipelines requiring low-latency temporary local storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E16ds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, running on an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor at 2.8 GHz via Microsoft Hyper-V. Based on the x86_64 architecture with 8 physical cores and multithreading, it incorporates AVX-512 extensions and 48 MB of L3 cache. The hardware bundle includes 644 GB of fast local SSD storage without integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Benchmark results show solid performance across key metrics, achieving 15.92 million Redis SET operations per second, uncached read memory bandwidth of 52.98 GB/sec, and a PassMark database score of 7,992.24. This combination of an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio and high-speed temporary storage makes the E16ds_v5 well configured for in-memory databases, large cache tiers, relational database engines, and data analytics workloads.
